tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtum mo ye shes rab 'bar gyi 'khrul 'khor bzhugs so//

/rtsa ba gsum la gus btud nas// gtum mo ye shes rab 'bar gyi// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor rnam pa drug /gab pa brjed 'jigs 'dir bri'o// me drod dbab dang gso dang sbar// spel dang dgram dang rngul sel drug /dang po drod dbab bya ba'i phyir// 'khor lo lta bur bskor ba ni// tsog pu lag gnyis pus 'khyud la// kha sbyor rlung dgang pho ba ni// g.yas dang g.yon skor drag tu bskor// gnyis pa me drod gso ba'i phyir// mda' gzhu lta bu bgengs pa ni// dpung g.yas dpung g.yon phyi zur dgyed// g.yas g.yon lag gnyis nang du bcar// slar yang de dag go bsgyur ba'o// gsum pa me drod sbar ba'i phyir// rdo rje lta bur stod smad 'then// sked nyag stod smad so sor 'then// bzhi pa me drod spel ba'i phyir// gtun shing lta bur brdung ba ni// 'bebs chen 'bebs chung bya ba yin// de ltar bzhi po lus rlung gnad// tsog pu lag bsdams rlung kha sbyor// lnga pa me drod dgram pa'i phyir// g.yang gzhi lta bur spugs pa ni// rlung gis ha zhes phyir dbyung zhing*// lus gnad sems skyil lus kun spug /drug pa lus rngul sel ba'i phyir// thal zhag byug pa'i phyag rgya ni// rlung ni rang so lus sems skyil// lag pas mgo lus yan lag kun// drag tu 'phur zhing mnye byug bya'o// drod dbab gso tshe gtum mo'i me// gsang gnas rkang sor bar du bsgom// sbar dang spel tshe me lce yis// lte snying mgrin gtsug sor rtse tshun// khyab dmigs dgram dang rngul sel tshe// dmigs med ngang nas 'khrul 'khor bya// zhes pa zhal rgyun brjed 'jigs nas// lha sras skye ba dbur smyon pas// bris kyi snod min rnams la gsang*// snod ldan re re tsam la spel// 'gal cha chos srung rnam gsum gyis/ */ bka' chad gnam lcags thog ltar phob// : : zhes pa ni 'khrul 'khor drug po yin la:

/de'i 'og tu yang dmigs pa dang sbyar 'khrul 'khor bya/ zhes pa'ang 'khrul 'khor drug po 'di ga yin zhing*/ de la'ang dang po byang sems dbab/ gnyis pa dkar dmar bsre/ gsum pa 'dren/ bzhi pa gnas so sor dgang*/ lnga pa rlung dang bsre/ drug pa rtsa mig thams cad du khyab cing bkram par byed pa'i phyir yin pas/ 'khrul 'khor drug po drod dang bde ba gnyis ka la med mi rung du snang bas so// //maṅga laṃ//
